output.explanation: The question asks for gross margin in EUR, but the warehouse has no currency information. None of the listed tables (marts.fct_order_lines, marts.fct_orders, marts.dim_products, marts.fct_payments, and so on) records the currency of amounts, and there is no exchange-rate table to convert them to EUR. Margins from the available columns (net_amount or net_revenue minus cogs or gross_margin) can only be reported in the warehouse's unstated base currency. Answering in EUR would require either a currency column for orders and a rate table, or confirmation of the base currency and an agreed exchange rate. Once one of those is available, the query would be: join marts.fct_order_lines to marts.dim_products for product_name, filter the orders from 2025 to status-based revenue (marts.fct_orders.is_revenue = true), compute SUM(net_amount - cogs) per product, convert it, and return the top 3.
